warnings: Jamie Madrox duplicates can have independent lives and memory asymmetries; do not automatically assign a dupe’s actions to Jamie.
Jamie–Layla romance is recorded only for the adult Layla after time displacement; no romantic claim is made about her as a 14-year-old recruit.
Shatterstar is the child of Dazzler and Longshot through a time loop; both parents’ memories were altered.
Guido’s resurrection without a soul is documented, but Layla’s intent and full causal mechanism are not verified from panels.
Guido kills Tier; do not infer a permanent disposition toward all children or unconditional moral blame without panels.
Carter Blaire and Alison’s conflict concerns her early career decision; no perpetual estrangement is established.
Several issue-specific placements are approximate, and all detailed biographies are publisher-secondary.
Cross-batch deduplication against unpublished batches is not exhaustive.
